entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Don't have it. It's under the name Sarah Jenkins.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... Sarah Jenkins... yes, I see it. The VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. Is that correct?
Alright. So, to get this processed correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I just don't want it anymore.
I understand. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility based on your delivery date... one moment.
Okay, great news. I see here that you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you right now.
Oh. Fine. I was getting ready to tell you all about the family **emergency** and the unexpected **surgery** that had me in the **hospital** for the last three weeks, but I guess it doesn't matter.

Oh, my goodness, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope you're recovering well. But yes, there's no need for any special exception, you're well within the standard timeframe. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file.
Whatever. As long as it's done.

It is. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in about 5-7 business days. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
